Figure 21:Correlation between LCE performance gains and optimization budgets (Left:LLM calls.Right:token consumption in millions).
Markers and error bars represent means and standard deviations, respectively, on both axes.
Neither correlation is significant. We find no evidence that larger optimization budgets are associated with more LCE performance gains.

Figure 22:Correlation between LCE performance gains
and theLeft:Baseline Task Accuracy andRight:Baseline Task Accuracy controlling for model size.
Markers and error bars show means and standard deviations on both axes for LCEs.
Both settings show the non-significant correlations. Improvements in baseline task accuracy brought by model scales are insufficient to contribute to better LCE performance gains.
